test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

No other place in this country is so better as Gulmarg, Kashmir.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the phrase "**so better as**."
 
• The correct comparative structure should be "**as good as**" instead of "so better as."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**as good as**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"No other place in this country is **as good as** Gulmarg, Kashmir."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "No other place,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "in this country is,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "Gulmarg, Kashmir,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
